title: Fine for what I wanted it for
text: Fine for what I wanted it for. This blanket is thin but I was looking for a decorative blanket, not one to keep me warm. If you want something to keep you very warm, this would be too thin. If you want something to really take the chill off, this might not do it. However, it is nicely made and the colors are vibrant. I am happy with the purchase and for my own use and what I wanted it for, I would give it a 5 but as it is sold as a blanket, I rated it so you would know it is not very thick and not going to help you like most blankets would.
